data.name: HelpChooseBody
data.value: Choose a project from the catalogue, or open a custom JSON/YAML definition or public HTTPS link. Exact revisions identify content; publisher names and directory inclusion do not authenticate a publisher.

data.name: HelpWorkBody
data.value: Complete the essential questions, then use Review to find remaining corrections. Files prepares a complete configuration or a deliberate incomplete draft. Download is available without revealing or copying the file first.

data.name: HelpReuseBody
data.value: Start from an existing configuration reuses a local file with Fill fields. Choose Compare with this definition for inspection only. Consent is required before either action reads a file; conflicting answers are never silently overwritten.

data.name: HelpCustodyBody
data.value: Answers and prepared files stay in this tab, outside appearance preferences and public caches. Closing or reloading clears them. Leaving a workspace asks you to discard current work.

data.name: HelpSecretsBody
data.value: Secret entry requires consent for each workspace. Revoking consent clears secret answers and prepared output. A secret-deferred draft still needs completion. Copy and Download deliberately transfer files to your chosen destination.

data.name: HelpTargetBody
data.value: A browser download cannot guarantee restricted native file permissions. The target application validates and authorizes use of the files; preparation does not mean they were accepted or applied.

data.name: HelpOfflineBody
data.value: Use Open configuration while online to prepare the application for offline use. Retain definitions only after confirming they are safe public content. Cached definitions contain no answers. The optional directory is not needed for bundled or local definitions.

data.name: HelpAppearanceBody
data.value: Open Settings in the navigation menu to choose appearance, contrast and text direction. These local preferences do not change configuration answers. Workspace tools contain the available editing modes and display options.
